# Chip

Composable Input and Filter chip; Selected is independent of hover, pressed, focus and disabled.

`RA.Chip` · 11c — Labels + Data

## Use

```jsx
<RA.Chip label={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="RA.Chip" label="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
